name: Scramjet
setupFrom: packages/demo (index.html, src/index.tsx, pages/BrowserView.tsx, public/sw.js, vite config)

release.note: the release is rebuilt from every push to main under the same tag; setup refuses a tarball whose sha256 differs from the pin and warns when the release says it was built from another commit

install.node: any current Node (only npm and esbuild run)

utils.source: packages/utils/src at sha (from the clone, else codeload.github.com)
utils.bundler: esbuild from the repo's node_modules, the shape of the repo's rspack IIFE build

serve./bench-config.js: generated by the adapter from this file

controller.scramjetConfig: the Controller's default (scramjet defaultConfig), not the demo's defaultConfigDev

transport.name: epoxy
transport.where: the host page's main thread (new EpoxyTransport(options) handed to the Controller)
transport.summary: epoxy-transport 3.0.2 (npm, epoxy-tls inlined) in the host page's main thread, over the shared holyWisp

notes: service worker: the demo's sw.js at / (scope /) importing /controller/controller.sw.js; it only forwards requests to the controller
one Controller in the host page (as the demo and bootstrap): fetch handling, HTML/JS/CSS rewriting and the transport all run on the host page's main thread, not in the service worker

scramjet config: the Controller's default (scramjet defaultConfig, what bootstrap/create-proxy-app use); the demo instead passes defaultConfigDev, which turns on debug flags (captureErrors, debugTrampolines, debugSourceURL) and allowInvalidJs off; those are dev aids and would slow it
flags in effect: sourcemaps on, destructureRewrites on, encapsulateWorkers on, allowInvalidJs on, syncxhr off, allowFailedIntercepts off (the controller sets it on, then merges defaultConfig over it)
URL codec: the controller default (encodeURIComponent under /~/sj/<controller>/<frame>/)
HttpCachePlugin on (demo and template both install it): caches upstream responses in the Cache API per RFC 9111, rewriting still runs on hits; no 304 revalidation

scramjet-utils is not in the release and npm 0.0.3 asserts scramjet 2.0.67-alpha.1 / controller 0.0.13, so packages/utils/src at 517206bc is bundled with esbuild; the demo's UrlWatcherPlugin and CatchEscapedLinksPlugin are UI plugins and are not installed

transport: epoxy (the demo offers epoxy and libcurl, default libcurl; epoxy chosen so every wisp contender uses epoxy); npm epoxy-transport 3.0.2 has stock epoxy-tls 2.1.20-1: the 16 KiB HTTP/2 header list limit STomp's patched build lifts, no HTTP/3, no ECH DoH
transport initializes lazily on the first proxied request (demo behaviour), so the epoxy wasm compile is inside the first load after boot
no cross-origin isolation headers on the host (the demo's vite server sends none)
